resolved_conflicts.explanation: A June 1945 notice proposed moving the Dix Hills tower to High Hill. The register records removal at Dix Hill in 1949 and does not mention a move. The story reports both and does not claim the move happened.

notes_for_editor: Brief's coordinates conflict (Forest Fire Lookout Association 40.8105, -73.346333 vs the Forest Lookouts list) was not verified in the pages read, so the story does not mention it. Brief's access 'unknown' is replaced by 'private' because the register says the land is privately held. No staffing or fire history found. One search used. The Bill Starr fire tower list (NHLR PDF) was seen only as a search snippet and is not cited.
